name: Paddle
description: The Paddle plugin connects Claude Code to Paddle Billing, a merchant of record for SaaS, AI, mobile app, and digital product businesses. It provides step-by-step guidance for the most common Paddle integration tasks and wires up the Paddle docs MCP server so Claude pulls from up-to-date documentation as it works — helping you follow Paddle's recommended patterns for checkout, subscriptions, and webhooks instead of guessing from stale examples.
longDescription:
Ships **10 skills** and **3 MCP servers**.

- **Skills** (10): `billing-history` (Render the authenticated user's billing history in Next.js — listing transactions via the Paddle Node SDK, the mandatory…), `catalog-setup` (Create the Paddle products and prices that other Paddle skills depend on — try MCP tools first, fall…), `checkout-web` (Add a Paddle Checkout to a Next.js web app — overlay or inline, with event handling, customer pre-fill,…), `customer-portal` (Mint a Paddle customer portal session URL from a Next.js Server Action — the portal-vs-custom-billing-screen trade-off, auth, ownership,…), `pricing-pages` (Render country-localized prices on a Next.js pricing page using Paddle.js PricePreview — country detection, billing frequency toggle, and…), `sandbox-testing` (Test a Paddle integration end-to-end using the sandbox environment, test cards, the webhook simulator, and local tunnels —…), `subscription-cancel` (Cancel a Paddle subscription from a Next.js Server Action — auth, ownership check, safe `effectiveFrom` default, revalidation, and…), `subscription-sync` (Mirror Paddle subscription and customer state into your database via webhooks — schema, upsert pattern, status semantics, scheduled…), and 2 more
- **MCP servers** (3): `paddle-docs`, `paddle-live`, `paddle-sandbox`

Installs with `claude plugin install paddle@claude-community` from `PaddleHQ/paddle-agent-skills` (`providers/claude/plugin`).
